description: This file defines the ProductViewModel class, which manages and exposes product data for an Android UI, including loading products, filtering by query, and retrieving products by ID.

classes.name: ProductViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel that holds product data, exposing methods to load, filter, and retrieve products, and maintaining internal state for product list.

methods.name: loadProducts
methods.description: Loads products from the repository and updates LiveData.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters the products based on a query string, updating the LiveData accordingly.

methods.name: getProductById
methods.description: Retrieves a product by its ID from the current list or repository.
